hypothesis: The region's cost should remain approximately constant across conditioning lengths because its tensor sizes are unchanged. Conditioning length distinguishes existing workload states so Dr. Perf can evaluate that hypothesis.

pcvs.name: noise_elements
pcvs.rationale: Captures the elementwise arithmetic workload, which is constant in this fixture.

pcvs.name: conditioning_length
pcvs.rationale: Provides three distinct entry states from the conditioning lengths exercised by the fixed workload, allowing comparison of the otherwise constant arithmetic cost across execution contexts.
